name: 27-oj Etazh
source:
"27th Floor" is a kinetic visual novel which tells the story of an unexpected and dramatic encounter between a girl and a guy who meet in the elevator of a skyscraper. They each have their own circumstances, their own past, their own dreams and hopes. How will this meeting turn out for them?

[Edited/translated from [url=https://occultioris.itch.io/27th-floor]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《27楼》是一部动态视觉小说，讲述了一个女孩和一个男孩在摩天大楼的电梯里相遇的意外而戏剧性的邂逅的故事。他们每个人都有自己的处境、自己的过去、自己的梦想和希望。这次会议对他们来说结果如何？

[编辑/翻译自[url=https://occultioris.itch.io/27th-floor]itch.io[/url]]
